definitions.full: H3000. Yeberekyahu יְבֶרֶכְיָ֫הוּ proper name, masculine (= יְבָרֶכְיָהוּ s. Yah blesseth Ges § 27 , 3) father of a Zechariah in Isaiah's time Isa 8:2 ; usually in abbreviated form as following: בֶּרֶכְיָה 1 son of Zerubbabel 1Chr 3:20 . 2 a Levite gruard of the ark 1Chr 9:16 ; 15:23 . 3 father of Meshullam , one of Nehemian's chiefs Neh 3:4 , 30 ; 6:18 . 4 father of the prophet Zechariah Zech 1:1 = בֶּרֶכְיָהוּ 1:7 ; בֶּרֶכְיָהוּ also 5 father of Asaph 1Chr 6:24 ; 15:17 . 6 Ephraimite chief 2Chr 28:12 . בֶּרֶכְיָהוּ בֶּרֶכְיָה, see יְבֶרֶכְיָהוּ above. ברם (compare Arabic twist a rope of two strands ).
